text:
morgan: quick preflight for onboarding zeta-qa-3b weights. need HF source location, s3 mirror status, checksum format (sha256?), and tokenizer parity check. CI already flagged a manifest/schema issue. who owns the registry mirror + who can grant presign/iam to artifact-ingest?

jess: HF repo is https://huggingface.co/org/zeta-qa-3b (main). our mirror prefix should be s3://rwd-artifacts/models/zeta-qa-3b/v1/ . perms are via artifact-ingest role (cross-account). manifest should include sha256 for weights and shards. quick checks:
```
# head object to verify existence
aws s3api head-object --bucket rwd-artifacts --key models/zeta-qa-3b/v1/model.bin
# download and checksum locally
aws s3 cp s3://rwd-artifacts/models/zeta-qa-3b/v1/model.bin ./model.bin
sha256sum model.bin
```
Include checksum in manifest as "weights_checksum": {"sha256": "..."}.

rahul: tokenizer quirk: tokenizer.json PAD token id is 1 in HF repo but our serving pipeline expects PAD id 0. simplest is to remap during tokenizer load or bake a converted tokenizer.json into the artifact. tiny script:
```py
# remap pad id example
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
# remap logic here, dump back
```
I'll draft the exact conversion snippet in the PR.

ci-bot: manifest-lint failed on pipeline: schema version mismatch (expected "v2"; found "v1"). Also manifest missing weights_checksum.sha256. see https://ci.internal/redwood/pipelines/7823/logs for details.

taylor: I can own the config PR. add an allow_tokenizer_overrides boolean flag with a short rationale (backwards compat + explicit opt-in). please include input length distribution in the model card. ping me on PR #4821 and i'll review.

morgan: thanks — i'll add the sha256 entry and note about tokenizer id. will open PR #4821 and tag @taylor. who will kick off the mirror job once PR merges?

li: I can run the mirror job. i'll trigger after PR merges and manifest + checksum present. please add the HF repo URL and manifest path to the mirror-config list or comment here. ETA ~2 business days for the mirror job to complete once started. also need to be on the source-access-list (artifact-ingest role) or infra will need to grant me cross-account access. :+1:

jess: presign TTL guidance: use 12h for debug artifacts, 30m for production presigned downloads. if cross-account, ensure bucket policy allows our presign principal. :thumbsup:

morgan: copied. i'll update manifest, add the tokenizer conversion note, and open PR today. thanks everyone. :rocket:
